text:
harper: kicking off a micro-canary for v3.4.0 in eu4 (initial 11%). change window 01:55-03:05 UTC. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/rollouts/1768302468
deploy-bot: rollout started: v3.4.0 -> 11% (eu4). cohort id: c-10117
canary-watch-bot: scheduled heatchecks at t+3m, t+10m.
maya: watching metrics now, will post snapshots.
deploy-bot: t+3m metrics: p50=102ms p95=215ms 5xx=0.25% kv-cache_miss_rate=0.9%
ivan: slight p95 tail on eu4-edge nodes hitting rdx-small-quant-mmap variant. tagging @ops-eng :eyes:
ops-eng: digging. pulling runtime allocation and mmap counters.
maya: t+8m p95 up to 470ms for a small cohort; 5xx 1.4% concentrated on /api/generate.
harper: manual pause request 12 hold at 11% while we triage.
deploy-bot: rollout paused at 11% (manual by harper). action: "user_pause" id=a-1768
ops-eng: logs show increased mmap faults and kv-cache churn on quant-mmap path. snippet:
```
[2026-03-23T02:47:02Z] host=eu4-03 model=rdx-small-quant-mmap latency=488ms mmap_faults=42 kv_misses=28 errors=0.9%
[2026-03-23T02:47:03Z] host=eu4-06 model=rdx-small-quant-mmap latency=512ms mmap_faults=57 kv_misses=33 errors=1.3%
```
release-manager: planned options: A) pin eu4 canary cohort to v3.3.9-quant-mmap-stable for 30m; B) regional rollback to v3.3.9; C) fallback to the non-quantized route for the cohort. Recommend A then evaluate.
ivan: +1 for pin. queueing rollback if pin fails after 12m: `/deploy rollback --service=inference --from=v3.4.0 --to=v3.3.9 --region=eu4 --fast-recover --reason="mmap_tail_latency"`
deploy-bot: note: change >10% outside quiet window requires change-window lock. current change falls inside window: 01:55-03:05 UTC 1 action allowed.
ops-eng: applying routing override to pin cohort c-10117 -> v3.3.9-quant-mmap-stable for eu4. override id=r-8034
deploy-bot: routing override applied r-8034.
canary-watch-bot: heatcheck t+6m after override: p95=182ms 5xx=0.35% mmap_faults reduced.
harper: good signal. propose hold 10 more minutes then resume to 25% with hard gates: p95<250ms and 5xx<0.6% and mmap_faults trending down.
maya: agree. will continue tail sampling and post summaries.
release-manager: if no improvement within 12m, execute queued rollback and update release notes with incident blurb + link to runbook: https://runbook.redwood/inference/kv-mmap-issue
ivan: queued rollback is in standby; ready to execute manually if needed.
ops-eng: monitoring. if resumed, prefer slow ramp with 5-min heatchecks per increment.
harper: thanks all, leaving ops-eng to monitor. ping here for any change. end.
